statement_summary: Maintain a written security program (POL-01 with P01, P02, P08)
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); Carrier DSA (16 CFR 314.3(a) benchmark)

statement_summary: Owner designated information security coordinator in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); Carrier DSA (16 CFR 314.4(b) benchmark)

statement_summary: Risk decision rules; High risks and money-movement risks always treated
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Annual policy review; questionnaires answered from the program
Sanctions for any future employee
Written, time-limited exceptions
No client data to a vendor without written terms, including 10-day breach notice
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a); Carrier DSA (16 CFR 314.4(f)(2) benchmark)

statement_summary: Vendor list with data held, terms, and review date
Vendor checklist before adopting a new service
Annual AMS SOC 2 review and customer controls; other vendors each August
Insurer addenda contacts and deadlines kept in the P08 matrix
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Own accounts; no shared credentials or one-time codes
MFA everywhere offered; authenticator app or security key for email and banking
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager, not the browser
Bookkeeper banking access view-only; owner alone moves money
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 30 seconds)
Sealed recovery codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly review of sign-ins, mailbox rules, connected apps, and AMS log; outside forwarding blocked
Trust account details only on the invoice template and client letter
Callback to a number on file before any payment detail change
Bank alerts on transfers and new payees; bookkeeper reports anomalies same day
Three-level data classification
Restricted and Confidential data only in approved systems
Documents through the AMS portal or secure links; texted ID photos uploaded and deleted
regulatory_driver: Carrier DSA (16 CFR 314.4(c)(3) benchmark); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)

statement_summary: Full-disk encryption on every device
Email and file backup with 1-year retention; quarterly AMS export
Retention schedule tied to 626.748, 626.561(2), and 501.171(4)(c)
Shred paper; wipe or destroy devices and printer storage; disposal log
Agency network separate from family devices; router password and firmware
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
AI tools only after assessment, no-training terms, and approval; agent checks AI drafts
Annual security training with business email compromise
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Breach determination with counsel; no-notice determinations kept 5 years and sent to the Department
Meet the notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Emergency servicing arrangement with another licensed agent
